items.name: diagram-design
items.description: 29 editorial diagram types for Claude Code. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows, no Mermaid-slop.

descriptions.zh: Claude Code 的 29 种编辑图表类型。独立的 HTML + SVG。没有阴影，没有美人鱼的污迹。
descriptions.en: 29 editorial diagram types for Claude Code. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows, no Mermaid-slop.

items.name: needle
items.description: 14MB foundation model for tiny devices; phones, wearables, smart home, and robots.

descriptions.zh: 适用于微型设备的 14MB 基础模型；手机、可穿戴设备、智能家居和机器人。
descriptions.en: 14MB foundation model for tiny devices; phones, wearables, smart home, and robots.

items.name: holehe
items.description: holehe allows you to check if the mail is used on different sites like twitter, instagram and will retrieve information on sites with the forgotten password function.

descriptions.zh: holehe 允许您检查邮件是否在 Twitter、Instagram 等不同网站上使用，并且会通过忘记密码功能检索网站上的信息。
descriptions.en: holehe allows you to check if the mail is used on different sites like twitter, instagram and will retrieve information on sites with the forgotten password function.

items.name: macro
items.description: Macro is a unified workspace for teams: email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM — @-linked together with shared AI memory.

descriptions.zh: Macro 是一个面向团队的统一工作空间：电子邮件、聊天、文档、任务、代理、呼叫和 CRM — 通过共享 AI 内存 @ 链接在一起。
descriptions.en: Macro is a unified workspace for teams: email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM — @-linked together with shared AI memory.

items.name: spiderfoot
items.description: SpiderFoot automates OSINT for threat intelligence and mapping your attack surface.

descriptions.zh: SpiderFoot 自动化 OSINT 以获取威胁情报并绘制攻击面图。
descriptions.en: SpiderFoot automates OSINT for threat intelligence and mapping your attack surface.

items.name: ego-lite
items.description: The fastest browser for AI agents to run browser automation, built for sharing your logged-in browser state with your AI agents, like Codex or Claude Code, without disturbing you. Zero cost, zero config.

descriptions.zh: AI 代理运行浏览器自动化的最快浏览器，专为与您的 AI 代理（如 Codex 或 Claude Code）共享您登录的浏览器状态而构建，而不会打扰您。零成本，零配置。
descriptions.en: The fastest browser for AI agents to run browser automation, built for sharing your logged-in browser state with your AI agents, like Codex or Claude Code, without disturbing you. Zero cost, zero config.
